summary: @servicetitan/log-service 38.1.1 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, then uses that freshly-fetched runtime to execute `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line, string-array-rotation-obfuscated JavaScript payload shipped at the tarball root. The obfuscated file exports nothing and exists only to be executed by the dropped Bun runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped outside the package.json `files` manifest (which declares only `dist` and `src`), a smuggling pattern inconsistent with the legitimate small TypeScript logging shim this scope publishes. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer via an alternate language runtime at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
